about: Voss's Personagens Leve with an integer step (the user, 2026-10-27: "refaz só o Voss Leve com passo inteiro (cada N-ésimo frame) e tempo fixo por frame, como os besteiros"): every clip cut exactly as cut.json (same stretch, loop search, keys), at ~610 px of figure (scaleTo), then every Nth frame, N = round(frames / 36), each held N frames' time; the game shows the full clip's frame f as f / N (roster lightStep). voss-veo-36-media (36 picked evenly from loops cut on 2026-10-22, before cut.json's walks and idle changed) kept, not in use.
figureNote: each clip's median hood top to boot row, as tall as voss-final's idle (the cast-back pose's note: 2.687 units)
